title: Ego2Act: Evaluating Goal-Directed Manipulation in Egocentric Video Generation
title_zh: Ego2Act：评估第一人称视频生成中的目标导向操作

paragraphs.en: Video generation models are increasingly being explored as world simulators for embodied planning and learning. To do so effectively, these models must not only generate visually appealing frames, but also predict how environments dynamically evolve when executing goal-directed actions. While evaluating these capabilities is crucial, existing benchmarks focus mainly on single short actions or step-by-step instructions. This leaves multi-step physical reasoning underexplored, especially in egocentric video generation that requires planning to simulate proper execution to accomplish high-level goals by carrying out multiple real-world manipulations. We introduce Ego2Act , a goal-directed benchmark featuring 2,640 videos from 110 real-world tasks across day-to-day settings, varying object clutter and multi-step complexity. Given an initial scene image and a high-level goal, Ego2Act evaluates whether video generation models can produce realistic egocentric videos of a hand manipulating objects to carry out the task. To support scalable evaluation, we also introduce Ego2ActJudge , a reference-free evaluation pipeline that achieves better task completion and physics plausibility evaluation alignment with human consensus compared to relevant baselines. Our findings reveal that models’ generated simulations often skip or partially execute steps,leaving later steps missing dependent states, which leads to unfulfilled goal. Furthermore, models consistently fail at fine-grained physical dynamics, particularly during complex object manipulation and persistent world modeling. We hope Ego2Act provides a rigorous testbed for advancing video models toward physically plausible, goal-directed simulation.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成模型正日益被探索用作具身规划与学习的世界模拟器。 为此，这些模型不仅要生成视觉上吸引人的帧，还必须预测在执行目标导向动作时环境如何动态演化。 尽管评估这些能力至关重要，现有基准主要聚焦于单个短动作或逐步指令。 这使得多步骤物理推理未被充分探索，尤其是在第一人称视频生成中，因为其需要通过规划来模拟正确的执行，从而完成多次真实世界操作以实现高层目标。 我们提出 Ego2Act，一个目标导向的基准，包含来自日常场景中110个真实世界任务的2,640个视频，涵盖不同的物体杂乱程度和多步骤复杂性。 给定初始场景图像和一个高层目标，Ego2Act 评估视频生成模型能否生成手部操作物体以执行任务的真实第一人称视频。 为支持可扩展的评估，我们还提出了 Ego2ActJudge，一个无参考的评估流程，与相关基线相比，它在任务完成度和物理合理性评估方面与人类共识具有更好的一致性。 我们的发现表明，模型生成的模拟常常跳过或部分执行步骤，导致后续步骤缺失其所依赖的状态，从而无法实现目标。 此外，模型在细粒度物理动力学上始终表现不佳，尤其是在复杂物体操作和持续性世界建模方面。 我们希望 Ego2Act 能为推动视频模型走向物理合理的、目标导向的模拟提供一个严格的测试平台。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in video generation have produced models capable of generating complex visual scenes and dynamic motion with better physical and world consistency ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; OpenAI, 2024 ) . Building on these foundations, researchers are exploring these models as embodied world simulators to support agents’ planning and learning, such as generating manipulation demonstrations for robot training ( Jang et al., 2025 ) or predicting action outcomes for embodied planning ( Bagchi et al., 2026 ) . However, effective agent learning requires video rollouts that are functionally valid, i.e., actions successfully reach the goal while executing a sequence of correct physical state changes. Evaluating these rollouts is challenging because goal-directed prompts state only the target outcome, leaving intermediate action sequences unspecified. Since multiple valid action paths can reach the goal, evaluation cannot rely on reference videos and must also verify physical constraints across diverse possibilities.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成领域的最新进展已经产生了能够生成复杂视觉场景和动态运动的模型，并且具有更好的物理一致性和世界一致性 ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; OpenAI, 2024 ) 。 在这些基础上，研究人员正在探索将这些模型作为具身世界模拟器，以支持智能体的规划与学习，例如为机器人训练生成操作示范 ( Jang et al., 2025 ) ，或为具身规划预测动作结果 ( Bagchi et al., 2026 ) 。 然而，有效的智能体学习需要在功能上有效的视频推演，即动作在执行一系列正确的物理状态变化的同时成功达成目标。 评估这些视频推演具有挑战性，因为目标导向的提示只说明了目标结果，而未指定中间的动作序列。 由于多条有效的动作路径都可以达成目标，评估不能依赖参考视频，还必须在不同可能性下验证物理约束。

paragraphs.en: To succeed in such goal-directed manipulation, a video model must autonomously infer the required intermediate actions and execute the physical state transitions needed to reach the target outcome ( Du et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Bagchi et al., 2026 ) . Consider an egocentric task in Figure 1 , where a model has to generate a demonstration of packing a capped toothpaste tube and a folded toothbrush into a travel case. The toothpaste can be capped before or after the toothbrush is folded, but both items must be prepared and packed before the case is closed. Evaluating such open-ended execution is challenging across video generation, but becomes especially demanding in egocentric settings where models must precisely track fine-grained object states through frequent hand occlusions and dynamic camera motion.
paragraphs.zh: 要在这种目标导向的操纵任务中取得成功，视频模型必须自主推断所需的中间动作，并执行达到目标结果所需的物理状态转换 ( Du et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Bagchi et al., 2026 ) 。 考虑图 1 中的一个第一人称视角任务，模型必须生成一段演示视频，展示将盖好盖子的牙膏管和折好的牙刷装进旅行盒的过程。 牙膏可以在牙刷折叠之前或之后盖上盖子，但在旅行盒关闭之前，两件物品都必须准备好并装进盒中。 评估这种开放式执行在视频生成领域本身就颇具挑战性，而在第一人称视角场景下尤为苛刻，因为模型必须在频繁的手部遮挡和动态相机运动中精确追踪细粒度的物体状态。

paragraphs.en: However, existing benchmarks fall short of evaluating such scenarios. Some evaluate complex demonstrations in exocentric settings ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , which bypasses the fine-grained hand-object interaction dynamics, end-effector occlusions, and dynamic view shifts native to egocentric perspectives. Conversely, existing egocentric benchmarks fail to evaluate autonomous planning, since they either evaluate generation with fidelity metrics rather than goal completion ( Shen et al., 2026 ) or their metrics rely on explicit, step-by-step prompt guidance ( Rong et al., 2026 ; Wei et al., 2026 ) . Consequently, they lack high-level, goal-directed task prompts required to test whether models can independently plan, execute, and track complex multi-step state transitions. paragraphs.zh: 然而，现有的基准测试不足以评估此类场景。 一些基准在第三人称视角设置下评估复杂的演示（Yang et al., 2026），这绕过了自我中心视角所固有的细粒度手-物体交互动态、末端执行器遮挡以及动态视角变化。 相反，现有的自我中心基准无法评估自主规划，因为它们要么用保真度指标而非目标完成度来评估生成结果（Shen et al., 2026），要么其指标依赖于显式的逐步提示引导（Rong et al., 2026; Wei et al., 2026）。 因此，它们缺乏高级的、目标导向的任务提示，无法测试模型能否独立地规划、执行并追踪复杂的多步状态转换。 为填补这一空白，我们提出两个关键研究问题：

paragraphs.en: To address RQ1 , we introduce Ego2Act , a goal-directed video generation benchmark that tests video models’ ability to generate complete, physically plausible executions of everyday egocentric tasks. Ego2Act consists of 110 real-world cases spanning diverse actions, domains, environmental clutter, and horizons, totaling 2,640 videos across 660 human-collected real videos and 1,980 model-generated outputs. Each case pairs a real-world starting scene with a high-level goal, requiring more than five steps on average that successful human executions take a median of 20.4 seconds. Our benchmark reveals a critical gap: state-of-the-art video models still struggle to generate goal-directed execution videos, with qualitative failure analysis showing that models frequently skip dependent steps or commit physical errors, exposing fine-grained execution failures that prior shorter horizon settings typically miss.
paragraphs.zh: 为回答研究问题一（RQ1），我们提出 Ego2Act，这是一个目标导向的视频生成基准，用于测试视频模型生成完整且符合物理规律的第一人称日常任务执行视频的能力。 Ego2Act 包含 110 个真实世界案例，涵盖多样的动作、领域、环境杂乱程度与时间跨度，共计 2,640 个视频，其中 660 个为人工采集的真实视频，1,980 个为模型生成的输出。 每个案例将真实世界的起始场景与一个高层目标配对，平均需要超过五个步骤，而成功的人类执行所需时间中位数为 20.4 秒。 我们的基准揭示了一个关键差距：最先进的视频模型仍然难以生成目标导向的执行视频，定性失败分析表明模型经常跳过依赖步骤或出现物理错误，暴露出先前较短时间跨度的设置通常无法捕捉的细粒度执行失败。

sents.en: To address RQ1 , we introduce Ego2Act , a goal-directed video generation benchmark that tests video models’ ability to generate complete, physically plausible executions of everyday egocentric tasks.

sents.en: Each case pairs a real-world starting scene with a high-level goal, requiring more than five steps on average that successful human executions take a median of 20.4 seconds.

sents.en: Our benchmark reveals a critical gap: state-of-the-art video models still struggle to generate goal-directed execution videos, with qualitative failure analysis showing that models frequently skip dependent steps or commit physical errors, exposing fine-grained execution failures that prior shorter horizon settings typically miss.
sents.zh: 我们的基准揭示了一个关键差距：最先进的视频模型仍然难以生成目标导向的执行视频，定性失败分析表明模型经常跳过依赖步骤或出现物理错误，暴露出先前较短时间跨度的设置通常无法捕捉的细粒度执行失败。

paragraphs.en: While identifying these failures provides critical insights into model limits, manually detecting such subtle, easily missed errors in open-ended manipulation videos is not trivial and scalable even for human annotators. To enable automatic evaluation at scale and answer RQ2 , we further introduce Ego2ActJudge , a reference-free, rubric-derived automated evaluator that assesses task completion and physical plausibility. Under human inspection on our subset panel, Seedance-2.0, the highest-scoring model, achieves an overall score of only 64.0 points, exposing a critical gap for future studies to bridge. We demonstrate evaluation reliability through high inter-annotator rubric agreement (ICC = 0.86) and strong alignment between Ego2ActJudge and human consensus ( r = 0.69 r=0.69 ) outperforming relevant baselines. We summarize our main contributions below:
paragraphs.zh: 虽然识别这些失败能为理解模型局限提供关键洞见，但在开放式操作视频中发现如此细微且容易被忽视的错误，即使对人工标注者而言也并非易事，且难以规模化。 为实现大规模自动评估并回答 RQ2，我们进一步提出了 Ego2ActJudge，一个免参考、基于评分细则的自动评估器，用于评估任务完成度与物理合理性。 在我们子集面板上的人工检查中，得分最高的模型 Seedance-2.0 总分仅为 64.0 分，暴露出未来研究亟需弥合的关键差距。 我们通过标注者间较高的评分细则一致性（ICC = 0.86）以及 Ego2ActJudge 与人类共识的强相关性（r = 0.69），超越了相关基线，证明了评估的可靠性。 我们将主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We introduce Ego2Act , to our knowledge, the first benchmark for goal-directed, multi-step egocentric video generation, comprising 110 real-world cases and 2,640 videos spanning diverse domains, environmental clutter, and action complexities.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Ego2Act，据我们所知，这是首个面向目标导向、多步骤第一人称视角视频生成的基准测试，包含 110 个真实世界案例和 2,640 个视频，涵盖多样化领域、环境杂乱程度及动作复杂性。

paragraphs.en: We propose Ego2ActJudge , a reference-free evaluation pipeline for open-ended manipulation rollouts that assesses task completion and physical plausibility, outperforming existing automated baselines in human alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Ego2ActJudge，一个无需参考的开放式操作轨迹评估流程，用于评估任务完成度与物理合理性，在人类一致性方面优于现有的自动化基线方法。

paragraphs.en: We present a comprehensive analysis of rubric design, model failure modes in egocentric physical execution, and the overall reliability of the proposed automated evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对量规设计、自我中心视角下物理执行中的模型失败模式，以及所提出的自动化评估的整体可靠性进行了全面分析。

paragraphs.en: Generative video models are increasingly utilized as embodied world simulators and predictive planners. Early frameworks adapt video generation to different control modalities: UniSim ( Yang et al., 2024 ) simulates visual outcomes from low-level actions, UniPi ( Du et al., 2023 ) optimizes goal-conditioned policies in video space, and VLP ( Du et al., 2024 ) performs tree search over generated video futures for multi-step planning. Recent works scale policy learning data by extracting robot trajectories in DreamGen ( Jang et al., 2025 ) or forecasting motor-conditioned egocentric rollouts in EgoWM ( Bagchi et al., 2026 ) . Most related to our setup, EgoForge ( Shen et al., 2026 ) generates first-person rollouts from initial scenes and instructions. In parallel, benchmarks like ALFRED ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ) and CALVIN ( Mees et al., 2022 ) test interactive agents in simulators, while EgoTV ( Hazra et al., 2023 ) verifies pre-recorded videos using subtask graphs. Whereas simulator agents and video checkers evaluate fixed interactions or pre-recorded traces, Ego2Act assesses whether video models can generate a complete and physically plausible multi-step task execution given a real-world egocentric initial scene image and the desired high-level final goal.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式视频模型正日益被用作具身世界模拟器与预测式规划器。 早期框架将视频生成适配到不同的控制模态：UniSim（Yang et al., 2024）从低层动作模拟视觉结果，UniPi（Du et al., 2023）在视频空间中优化目标条件策略，而 VLP（Du et al., 2024）在生成的视频未来上执行树搜索以进行多步规划。 近期工作通过在 DreamGen（Jang et al., 2025）中提取机器人轨迹，或在 EgoWM（Bagchi et al., 2026）中预测以运动状态为条件的自我中心推演，来扩展策略学习数据。 与我们的设置最相关的是 EgoForge（Shen et al., 2026），它根据初始场景和指令生成第一人称推演。 与此同时，ALFRED（Shridhar et al., 2020）和 CALVIN（Mees et al., 2022）等基准在模拟器中测试交互式智能体，而 EgoTV（Hazra et al., 2023）则使用子任务图验证预先录制的视频。 模拟器中的智能体与视频校验器评估的是固定交互或预先录制的轨迹，而 Ego2Act 则评估视频模型在给定真实世界的自我中心初始场景图像和期望的高层最终目标时，能否生成完整且物理上合理的多步任务执行过程。

sents.zh: 模拟器中的智能体与视频校验器评估的是固定交互或预先录制的轨迹，而 Ego2Act 则评估视频模型在给定真实世界的自我中心初始场景图像和期望的高层最终目标时，能否生成完整且物理上合理的多步任务执行过程。

paragraphs.en: General video evaluation frameworks like VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) and VideoScore ( He et al., 2024 ) focus on visual quality and prompt alignment, but fail to verify subgoal progress in multi-step execution. VideoPhy-2 ( Bansal et al., 2026 ) and PQSG ( Pothiraj et al., 2026 ) evaluate physical and logical adherence. Embodied benchmarks assess instruction following and physics in DreamGen ( Jang et al., 2025 ) and WorldModelBench ( Li et al., 2025 ) , multi-step planning in RBench ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , action simulation in WR-Arena ( PAN Team et al., 2026 ) , general world model capabilities in WoW-World-Eval ( Fan et al., 2026 ) , and robotic execution in RoboWM-Bench ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) . While EgoForge ( Shen et al., 2026 ) shares our generation interface, it is a generation method rather than a benchmark, and it is evaluated with reference-based visual fidelity metrics rather than goal completion. In contrast, Ego2Act evaluates multi-step goal completion and its physical accuracy, which Ego2ActJudge automates directly without requiring reference trajectories. In summary, we outline the novelty of Ego2Act in Table 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 诸如 VBench（Huang et al., 2024）和 VideoScore（He et al., 2024）等通用视频评估框架关注视觉质量和提示对齐，但无法验证多步执行中的子目标进展。 VideoPhy-2（Bansal et al., 2026）和 PQSG（Pothiraj et al., 2026）评估物理与逻辑一致性。 具身基准评估 DreamGen（Jang et al., 2025）和 WorldModelBench（Li et al., 2025）中的指令遵循与物理特性、RBench（Deng et al., 2026）中的多步规划、WR-Arena（PAN Team et al., 2026）中的动作模拟、WoW-World-Eval（Fan et al., 2026）中的通用世界模型能力，以及 RoboWM-Bench（Jiang et al., 2026）中的机器人执行。 尽管 EgoForge（Shen et al., 2026）与我们的生成接口相同，但它是一种生成方法而非基准，并且其评估基于参考型视觉保真度指标而非目标完成度。 相比之下，Ego2Act 评估多步目标完成度及其物理准确性，而 Ego2ActJudge 可直接自动化这一评估，无需参考轨迹。 总结而言，我们在表 1 中概述了 Ego2Act 的创新之处。

paragraphs.en: Given an initial scene image f 1 f_{1} and a goal prompt G G , Ego2Act measures whether video models can generate a physically plausible embodied video sequence V = { f 1 , f 2 , … , f T } V=\{f_{1},f_{2},\dots,f_{T}\} that executes the task using only items visible in f 1 f_{1} . The benchmark primarily evaluates two evaluation axes. (1) Task completion verifies that a generated sequence performs the intermediate steps needed to arrive at goal state G G . (2) Physical plausibility assesses whether hand-object contacts, object persistence under occlusion, and state changes stay realistic throughout execution. Since G G only outlines the target outcome without prescribing any ground truth sequence, any rollout reaching the goal under plausible physics counts as successful. Ego2Act is scored by human raters and Ego2ActJudge , following the protocol in Section 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 给定初始场景图像 f 1 f_{1} 和目标提示 G G ，Ego2Act 衡量视频模型能否生成物理上合理的具身视频序列 V = { f 1 , f 2 , … , f T } V=\{f_{1},f_{2},\dots,f_{T}\} ，该序列仅使用 f 1 f_{1} 中可见的物品来执行任务。 该基准主要评估两个评估维度。 （1）任务完成度验证生成的序列是否执行了达到目标状态 G G 所需的中间步骤。 （2）物理合理性评估手-物体接触、遮挡下的物体持续性以及状态变化在整个执行过程中是否保持真实。 由于 G G 仅概述目标结果而未规定任何真值序列，任何在合理物理条件下达到目标的生成序列都算作成功。 Ego2Act 由人类评分员和 Ego2ActJudge 按照第 4 节中的协议进行评分。

paragraphs.en: To construct Ego2Act , we manually collect real-world scenes and human task recordings, then annotate their environments, complexity, and execution features. Each case includes 6 human recordings: 3 successful attempts with distinct action sequences and 3 unsuccessful attempts as controls. We also prompt 6 video models to generate 3 videos across different trials (seeds), resulting in 18 generated videos per case. The final benchmark contains 110 cases, with 660 human recordings and 1,980 generated videos, totaling 2,640 videos.
paragraphs.zh: 为了构建 Ego2Act，我们人工收集真实场景和人类任务录制视频，然后对其环境、复杂度和执行特征进行标注。 每个案例包含 6 段人类录制视频：3 段动作序列各不相同的成功尝试，以及 3 段作为对照的失败尝试。 我们还提示 6 个视频模型在不同试验（种子）下各生成 3 个视频，从而每个案例得到 18 个生成视频。 最终的基准包含 110 个案例，共 660 段人类录制视频和 1,980 个生成视频，总计 2,640 个视频。

sents.en: To construct Ego2Act , we manually collect real-world scenes and human task recordings, then annotate their environments, complexity, and execution features.
sents.zh: 为了构建 Ego2Act，我们人工收集真实场景和人类任务录制视频，然后对其环境、复杂度和执行特征进行标注。

sents.en: Each case includes 6 human recordings: 3 successful attempts with distinct action sequences and 3 unsuccessful attempts as controls.
sents.zh: 每个案例包含 6 段人类录制视频：3 段动作序列各不相同的成功尝试，以及 3 段作为对照的失败尝试。

sents.en: We also prompt 6 video models to generate 3 videos across different trials (seeds), resulting in 18 generated videos per case.
sents.zh: 我们还提示 6 个视频模型在不同试验（种子）下各生成 3 个视频，从而每个案例得到 18 个生成视频。

sents.en: The final benchmark contains 110 cases, with 660 human recordings and 1,980 generated videos, totaling 2,640 videos.
sents.zh: 最终的基准包含 110 个案例，共 660 段人类录制视频和 1,980 个生成视频，总计 2,640 个视频。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark spans five task categories: kitchen and food preparation, household organization and storage, personal care and utilities, office and study workspace, and other everyday activities. We assign annotators to a category, then ask them to propose a task conforming to this. We then verify the appropriateness of the proposed task and discard examples violating our requirements as outlined in Appendix A.1 . Scenes cover three clutter levels: none, minimal, and heavy, which annotators assign by judging the amount of task-irrelevant content visible in the initial scene. Each case pairs an initial scene image f 1 f_{1} with an outcome-oriented goal G G that specifies the desired result without prescribing intermediate steps. We verify that each case admits at least 3 distinct execution sequences across its human recordings. Sequences are considered distinct if they differ in either: (1) sub-action sequencing (e.g. washing a mug before wiping the counter vs. wiping first), (2) resource or tool selection (e.g. using a sponge vs. a paper towel), or (3) intermediate state transitions (e.g. storing an item in a drawer vs. placing it on a shelf). Appendix A.1 provides detailed construction criteria and operational definitions.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准涵盖五大任务类别：厨房与食物准备、家庭收纳与整理、个人护理与日常用品、办公与学习工作区，以及其他日常活动。 我们为标注员分配一个类别，然后要求他们据此提出一个符合该类别的任务。 随后我们验证所提出任务的适当性，并舍弃违反附录 A.1 中所述要求的示例。 场景涵盖三个杂乱程度：无、轻微和严重，标注员通过判断初始场景中可见的与任务无关内容的数量来进行分配。 每个案例将初始场景图像 f 1 f_{1} 与以结果为导向的目标 G G 配对，该目标指定期望的结果而不规定中间步骤。 我们验证每个案例在其人类录制中至少存在 3 条不同的执行序列。 序列在满足以下任一条件时被视为不同：(1) 子动作顺序不同（例如先洗杯子再擦台面 vs. 先擦台面），(2) 资源或工具选择不同（例如使用海绵 vs. 使用纸巾），或 (3) 中间状态转移不同（例如将物品放入抽屉 vs. 放在架子上）。 附录 A.1 提供了详细的构建标准和操作性定义。

paragraphs.en: Human recordings must maintain an egocentric perspective, record with sufficient brightness, and follow the closed-world constraint. Objects may move out of view during execution, but no additional objects can be introduced. Human recordings violating this constraint are excluded. Before including a case, annotators review its goal definition clarity and outcome-oriented wording, task feasibility, absence of duplicate tasks, and metadata accuracy. They then inspect the human recordings for visual quality, viewpoint and orientation consistency, and compliance with the collection constraints. Appendix A.1 provides the detailed verification protocol. The final collection contains 110 verified cases. We resize initial scene images so that their longest side is 512 pixels while preserving aspect ratio. Human recordings and generated videos are also resized to 480p to ensure that Ego2ActJudge and all baselines receive inputs of identical resolution and quality for fair comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 人类录像必须保持以自我为中心的视角，在足够的亮度下录制，并遵循封闭世界约束。 物体在执行过程中可能移出视野，但不能引入额外的物体。 违反此约束的人类录像将被排除。 在纳入一个案例之前，标注者会审查其目标定义的清晰度和面向结果的措辞、任务可行性、是否存在重复任务，以及元数据的准确性。 然后，他们会检查人类录像的视觉质量、视角和朝向的一致性，以及是否符合采集约束。 附录 A.1 提供了详细的验证协议。 最终的集合包含 110 个经过验证的案例。 我们对初始场景图像进行缩放，使其最长边为 512 像素，同时保持宽高比。 人类录像和生成的视频也被缩放至 480p，以确保 Ego2ActJudge 和所有基线接收相同分辨率和质量的输入，从而进行公平比较。

sents.en: They then inspect the human recordings for visual quality, viewpoint and orientation consistency, and compliance with the collection constraints.
sents.zh: 然后，他们会检查人类录像的视觉质量、视角和朝向的一致性，以及是否符合采集约束。

sents.en: Appendix A.1 provides the detailed verification protocol.
sents.zh: 附录 A.1 提供了详细的验证协议。

sents.en: The final collection contains 110 verified cases.
sents.zh: 最终的集合包含 110 个经过验证的案例。

sents.en: We resize initial scene images so that their longest side is 512 pixels while preserving aspect ratio.
sents.zh: 我们对初始场景图像进行缩放，使其最长边为 512 像素，同时保持宽高比。

sents.en: Human recordings and generated videos are also resized to 480p to ensure that Ego2ActJudge and all baselines receive inputs of identical resolution and quality for fair comparison.
sents.zh: 人类录像和生成的视频也被缩放至 480p，以确保 Ego2ActJudge 和所有基线接收相同分辨率和质量的输入，从而进行公平比较。

paragraphs.en: For each human recording, we annotate: (1) a high-level description of the attempted trajectory, (2) the number of subactions, (3) video duration, (4) task-relevant objects, (5) their attributes (e.g., color), and (6) action types. These annotations describe the benchmark composition (Figure 2 ) and is different with judgement annotation guideline that is detailed in Section 4 . A detailed breakdown of our annotation methodology is provided in Appendix A.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于每段人类录制视频，我们标注：（1）所尝试轨迹的高层描述，（2）子动作的数量，（3）视频时长，（4）与任务相关的物体，（5）它们的属性（例如颜色），以及（6）动作类型。 这些标注描述了基准的构成（图2），这与第4节中详述的判断标注指南不同。 我们标注方法的详细说明见附录A.3。

paragraphs.en: We build Ego2ActJudge based on human-crafted rubrics to construct a multi-stage VQA evaluation pipeline. Operating without training or reference trajectories, the evaluator receives video V V and goal G G to output a score triplet of (task score T T , physics score P P , final score S S ). The overall pipeline is illustrated in Figure 3 , with full rubrics, scoring rules, and pipeline implementation details provided in Appendix B . Below, we formalize the four primary stages of this evaluation pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 我们基于人工制定的评分标准构建了 Ego2ActJudge，以搭建一个多阶段的 VQA 评估流水线。 该评估器无需训练或参考轨迹，接收视频 V V 和目标 G G，输出一个分数三元组（任务分数 T T、物理分数 P P、最终分数 S S）。 整体流水线如图 3 所示，完整的评分标准、评分规则以及流水线实现细节见附录 B。 下面，我们对该评估流水线的四个主要阶段进行形式化描述。

sents.en: We build Ego2ActJudge based on human-crafted rubrics to construct a multi-stage VQA evaluation pipeline.
sents.zh: 我们基于人工制定的评分标准构建了 Ego2ActJudge，以搭建一个多阶段的 VQA 评估流水线。

sents.en: Operating without training or reference trajectories, the evaluator receives video V V and goal G G to output a score triplet of (task score T T , physics score P P , final score S S ).
sents.zh: 该评估器无需训练或参考轨迹，接收视频 V V 和目标 G G，输出一个分数三元组（任务分数 T T、物理分数 P P、最终分数 S S）。

sents.en: The overall pipeline is illustrated in Figure 3 , with full rubrics, scoring rules, and pipeline implementation details provided in Appendix B .
sents.zh: 整体流水线如图 3 所示，完整的评分标准、评分规则以及流水线实现细节见附录 B。

sents.en: Below, we formalize the four primary stages of this evaluation pipeline.
sents.zh: 下面，我们对该评估流水线的四个主要阶段进行形式化描述。

paragraphs.en: (1) Subgoals. Given goal G G and scene f 1 f_{1} derived from V V without viewing the whole video, Ego2ActJudge identifies a minimal set of observable subgoals 𝒢 = { g 1 , … , g N } \mathcal{G}=\{g_{1},\ldots,g_{N}\} , where each subgoal involves one source object, at most one target, and one action. For example, moving object A A to location B B is a single valid subgoal, whereas moving A A and B B together to C C is split due to multi-object definition on one side. Although the plan is re-derived for every video, it is largely stable: 91% of plans keep the same subgoal count and they name nearly the same objects (Appendix G ).
paragraphs.zh: (1) 子目标。 给定目标 G G 和从 V V 导出的场景 f 1 f_{1}（无需观看整个视频），Ego2ActJudge 识别出一个最小可观察子目标集合 𝒢 = { g 1 , … , g N } \mathcal{G}=\{g_{1},\ldots,g_{N}\}，其中每个子目标涉及一个源对象、至多一个目标对象以及一个动作。 例如，将对象 A A 移动到位置 B B 是单个有效子目标，而将 A A 和 B B 一起移动到 C C 则因单侧多对象的定义而被拆分。 尽管该计划会针对每个视频重新推导，但它基本上是稳定的：91% 的计划保持相同的子目标数量，并且它们命名了几乎相同的对象（附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: (2) Task completion. For each subgoal g i g_{i} , the judge evaluates task execution through three gates, binary checks applied in order until one fails (early exit): T1 whether action initiation occurs, T2 whether the coarse-level interaction process takes place, and T3 whether the post-process state matches the desired outcome. Evaluation halts at the first failed gate, producing a discrete score t i ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 } t_{i}\in\{0,1,2,3\} , the number of gates passed. We compute the task completion score as the mean across subgoals, T = 1 N ​ ∑ i = 1 N t i T=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}t_{i} . Appendix B.1 details the task rubric and gate criteria.
paragraphs.zh: (2) 任务完成度。 对于每个子目标 g i g_{i} ，裁判通过三道门评估任务执行情况，这些门是按顺序应用的二元检查，直到某一道未通过（提前退出）：T1 是否发生动作发起，T2 是否进行了粗粒度的交互过程，以及 T3 处理后的状态是否与期望结果相符。 评估在第一道未通过的门处停止，产生一个离散分数 t i ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 } t_{i}\in\{0,1,2,3\} ，即通过的门的数量。 我们将任务完成度分数计算为各子目标上的平均值，T = 1 N ​ ∑ i = 1 N t i T=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}t_{i} 。 附录 B.1 详细说明了任务评分标准与门的判定条件。

paragraphs.en: (3) Physics Plausibility. For each subgoal g i g_{i} , we assess physical validity independently of task success across four gates: P1 state and object continuity, P2 physically valid causation at interaction onset, P3 plausible contact during the interaction process, and P4 post-interaction physical stability. Scoring halts at the first failed gate, yielding a discrete score p i ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 } p_{i}\in\{0,1,2,3,4\} . An unattempted subgoal ( t i = 0 t_{i}=0 ) involves no physical interaction, so it is marked unattempted ( N / A \mathrm{N/A} ) rather than scored. The physics score P P is averaged only over the set of evaluated subgoals 𝒥 ⊆ 𝒢 \mathcal{J}\subseteq\mathcal{G} via P = 1 | 𝒥 | ​ ∑ i ∈ 𝒥 p i P=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{J}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{J}}p_{i} , which is undefined when 𝒥 \mathcal{J} is empty. Appendix B.2 details the physical plausibility rubric and operational rules.
paragraphs.zh: (3) 物理合理性。 对于每个子目标 g i g_{i}，我们独立于任务成功与否，通过四个关卡评估其物理有效性：P1 状态与物体的连续性，P2 交互开始时物理上有效的因果关系，P3 交互过程中合理的接触，以及 P4 交互后的物理稳定性。 评分在第一个未通过的关卡处停止，得到离散分数 p i ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 } p_{i}\in\{0,1,2,3,4\}。 未尝试的子目标（ t i = 0 t_{i}=0）不涉及物理交互，因此被标记为未尝试（ N / A \mathrm{N/A}）而不予评分。 物理分数 P P 仅在被评估的子目标集合 𝒥 ⊆ 𝒢 \mathcal{J}\subseteq\mathcal{G} 上取平均，即 P = 1 | 𝒥 | ​ ∑ i ∈ 𝒥 p i P=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{J}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{J}}p_{i}，当 𝒥 \mathcal{J} 为空时该分数无定义。 附录 B.2 详述了物理合理性评分标准及操作规则。

paragraphs.en: (4) Final Score Aggregation. Since T T and P P capture distinct evaluation axes, we integrate them into an overall score using their geometric mean, S = T ⋅ P S=\sqrt{T\cdot P} . This multiplicative coupling ensures that severe failures in either task execution or physical validity strongly suppress the final score. A rollout that attempts no subgoals ( T = 0 T=0 , leaving P P undefined) represents a complete failure and is assigned S = 0 S=0 , ensuring it remains factored into benchmark averages rather than being omitted. See Appendix B.4 for a complete justification of this scoring rule.
paragraphs.zh: (4) 最终得分聚合。 由于 T T 和 P P 刻画的是不同的评估维度，我们使用它们的几何平均数将其整合为一个总分，S = T ⋅ P S=\sqrt{T\cdot P} 。 这种乘法耦合确保任务执行或物理有效性中任一方面的严重失败都会强烈压低最终得分。 一个未尝试任何子目标的 rollout（T = 0 T=0 ，此时 P P 未定义）代表完全失败，并被赋值为 S = 0 S=0 ，从而确保其被计入基准平均值而非被忽略。 关于该评分规则的完整论证见附录 B.4。

sents.zh: (4) 最终得分聚合。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 6 video generation models: Grok Imagine 1.5 ( xAI, 2026 ) , Seedance 2.0 ( Team Seedance, 2026 ) , Cosmos 3 ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) , Kling v3 Pro ( Kling AI, 2026 ) , MiniMax H3 ( MiniMax, 2026 ) , and Wan 2.7 ( Alibaba, 2026 ) . We generate videos at 480p using 16:9 aspect ratio, except for MiniMax H3, which uses its native 4:3 format. We set the maximum generation duration to 15s for all models except Wan 2.7, which supports only up to 10s, and all models receive the same generation prompt template (Appendix A.4 ). For Ego2ActJudge and other training-free baselines, we use Gemini-3.7-Flash as our video understanding backbone, motivated by our backbone comparison experiment in Section 5.4 and its affordability.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了 6 个视频生成模型：Grok Imagine 1.5（ xAI, 2026 ）、Seedance 2.0（ Team Seedance, 2026 ）、Cosmos 3（ NVIDIA, 2026 ）、Kling v3 Pro（ Kling AI, 2026 ）、MiniMax H3（ MiniMax, 2026 ）以及 Wan 2.7（ Alibaba, 2026 ）。 我们以 480p 分辨率和 16:9 的宽高比生成视频，但 MiniMax H3 除外，它使用其原生的 4:3 格式。 我们将所有模型的最大生成时长设为 15 秒，但仅支持最长 10 秒的 Wan 2.7 除外，并且所有模型都使用相同的生成提示词模板（附录 A.4 ）。 对于 Ego2ActJudge 和其他免训练基线，我们使用 Gemini-3.7-Flash 作为视频理解骨干模型，这一选择基于第 5.4 节中的骨干模型对比实验及其较低的成本。

paragraphs.en: For human evaluation, three annotators score videos from a 25-case panel (600 videos) with the task and physics rubrics of Section 4 . Each video is assigned anonymously to each annotator, who are blind to the generating model information and complete a calibration session beforehand. We evaluate Ego2ActJudge against six baselines across three paradigm categories: (1) Simple VQA , a single-prompt control using our simplified rubric, (2) structured question-graph baselines, PQSG ( Pothiraj et al., 2026 ) , RBench ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , and WR-Arena ( PAN Team et al., 2026 ) , which assess manipulation fidelity without fine-tuning, and (3) fine-tuned perceptual evaluators, WorldModelBench ( Li et al., 2025 ) and VideoScore ( He et al., 2024 ) . Appendix D details annotation protocols, subset composition, and agreement metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 在人类评估中，三名标注者使用第 4 节的任务与物理评分标准，对一个包含 25 个案例的面板（600 个视频）进行打分。 每个视频以匿名方式分配给每位标注者，他们对生成该视频的模型信息不知情，并事先完成一次校准训练。 我们在三种范式类别下将 Ego2ActJudge 与六个基线进行比较：(1) Simple VQA，即使用我们简化评分标准的单提示对照方法；(2) 结构化问题图基线，包括 PQSG（Pothiraj 等，2026）、RBench（Deng 等，2026）和 WR-Arena（PAN Team 等，2026），它们在不进行微调的情况下评估操控保真度；(3) 微调后的感知评估器，包括 WorldModelBench（Li 等，2025）和 VideoScore（He 等，2024）。 附录 D 详细说明了标注协议、子集构成以及一致性指标。

sents.en: For human evaluation, three annotators score videos from a 25-case panel (600 videos) with the task and physics rubrics of Section 4 .

sents.en: Each video is assigned anonymously to each annotator, who are blind to the generating model information and complete a calibration session beforehand.
sents.zh: 每个视频以匿名方式分配给每位标注者，他们对生成该视频的模型信息不知情，并事先完成一次校准训练。

sents.en: We evaluate Ego2ActJudge against six baselines across three paradigm categories: (1) Simple VQA , a single-prompt control using our simplified rubric, (2) structured question-graph baselines, PQSG ( Pothiraj et al., 2026 ) , RBench ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , and WR-Arena ( PAN Team et al., 2026 ) , which assess manipulation fidelity without fine-tuning, and (3) fine-tuned perceptual evaluators, WorldModelBench ( Li et al., 2025 ) and VideoScore ( He et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 我们在三种范式类别下将 Ego2ActJudge 与六个基线进行比较：(1) Simple VQA，即使用我们简化评分标准的单提示对照方法；(2) 结构化问题图基线，包括 PQSG（Pothiraj 等，2026）、RBench（Deng 等，2026）和 WR-Arena（PAN Team 等，2026），它们在不进行微调的情况下评估操控保真度；(3) 微调后的感知评估器，包括 WorldModelBench（Li 等，2025）和 VideoScore（He 等，2024）。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation on Ego2Act reveals video models capability gap relative to human execution.As shown in Table 2 , proprietary models lead, with Seedance-2.0 scoring highest on aggregate. Among open-weight models, MiniMax-H3 remains competitive, which we attribute to its larger parameter scale and provider-side prompt expansion. We analyze this rewriting behavior through a dedicated prompt ablation study in Appendix E.4 , finding that while prompt expansion can boost performance for certain models, its benefits do not reliably generalize across architectures. On per-aspect score relations (Figure 4(a) ), there is a moderate positive correlation between both axes, but the wide spread of points highlights large per-sample variance, indicating that task success and physical accuracy do not strictly track one another. Furthermore, as reflected by the shift from human centroids (orange) toward judge centroids (blue), automated evaluators exhibit an upward scoring bias relative to human raters. Scores also fluctuate considerably across seeds (Figure 4(b) ). Our analysis reveals that physical realism and task success are only moderately coupled and show high per-sample variance, making them unreliable predictors of one another, and multi-trial sampling is essential for dependable evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Ego2Act 上的评估揭示了视频模型相对于人类执行的能力差距。如表 2 所示，专有模型处于领先地位，其中 Seedance-2.0 在总体得分上最高。 在开源权重模型中，MiniMax-H3 仍具竞争力，我们将此归因于其更大的参数规模以及提供方侧的提示词扩展。 我们通过附录 E.4 中一项专门的提示词消融研究分析了这种改写行为，发现尽管提示词扩展可以提升某些模型的性能，但其收益并不能可靠地泛化到不同架构上。 在各维度分数关系方面（图 4(a)），两个坐标轴之间存在中等程度的正相关，但数据点的广泛分布凸显了较大的单样本方差，表明任务成功与物理准确性并不严格同步。 此外，从人类质心（橙色）向评审质心（蓝色）的偏移反映出，自动化评估器相对于人类评分者表现出评分偏高的倾向。 分数在不同随机种子之间也波动明显（图 4(b)）。 我们的分析表明，物理真实感与任务成功之间仅有中等程度的耦合，且表现出较高的单样本方差，使二者无法可靠地相互预测，因此多次试验采样对于可靠的评估至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Among the features we analyze, action type causes the largest differences in generation quality, whereas there is no no significant association from coarse scene features (clutter level, object count). Task length has a weak negative correlation with performance (Spearman ρ = − 0.29 \rho=-0.29 ), indicating that while longer tasks tend to be harder, length alone is a poor predictor of generation failure as models still frequently fail on shorter-horizon tasks. To pinpoint which actions cause failures, we conduct isolated study at the subgoal level, where each step has one primary action family and errors can be located independently of the rest of the subgoals. Attachment/connection subgoals are the hardest, reaching 38.6% Task completion and 66.7% Physics validity, compared with 51.1% and 75.5% for relocation/arrangement, while material transfer/mixing is most often left incomplete. This observation holds across all models, exposing a common bottleneck in performing state-changing, contact-heavy dynamics, and highlighting their limitation in simulating fine-grained physical contact and persistent state transformations. (see Appendices E.3 and E.2 for detailed breakdowns).
paragraphs.zh: 在我们分析的特征中，动作类型对生成质量造成的差异最大，而粗粒度场景特征（杂乱程度、物体数量）则没有显著关联。 任务长度与性能呈弱负相关（Spearman ρ = −0.29），表明虽然较长的任务往往更难，但仅凭长度难以预测生成失败，因为模型在较短的任务上仍频繁失败。 为了精确定位哪些动作导致失败，我们在子目标层面进行了独立研究，其中每个步骤包含一个主要动作族，错误可以独立于其余子目标进行定位。 附着/连接类子目标最难，任务完成率为38.6%，物理有效性为66.7%，而搬迁/布置类分别为51.1%和75.5%；材料转移/混合则最常处于未完成状态。 这一观察在所有模型中均成立，揭示了它们在执行改变状态、重度接触的动态过程中的共同瓶颈，并凸显了它们在模拟细粒度物理接触和持久状态变换方面的局限。 （详细分解见附录E.3和E.2）。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 3 , our rubric achieves high inter-annotator agreement, and our pipeline aligns more closely with human consensus than existing evaluators. Humans and Ego2ActJudge also rank the six generators almost identically (Spearman ρ = 0.94 \rho=0.94 ), swapping only the adjacent Grok-1.5 and MiniMax-H3. Furthermore, the lower alignment of the rubric-derived single-prompt Simple VQA suggests that the early-exit structure helps on better alignment and reducing errors natural to stochasiticity of plain prompting. Table 2 also exposes flaws in prior metrics: perception-heavy evaluators like VideoScore score positive and negative human controls almost identically, and action-oriented evaluators such as PQSG and RBench show lower overall correlation because their scores remain insensitive to drops in physical plausibility. Appendix D.2 details the full alignment results which includes leave-out study and…
paragraphs.zh: 如表 3 所示，我们的评分标准（rubric）达到了较高的标注者间一致性，且我们的流程比现有评估器更贴近人类共识。 人类与 Ego2ActJudge 对六个生成器的排序也几乎完全相同（Spearman ρ = 0.94 \rho=0.94），仅相邻的 Grok-1.5 和 MiniMax-H3 位置互换。 此外，由评分标准派生的单提示词 Simple VQA 对齐度较低，这表明提前退出结构有助于实现更好的对齐，并减少纯提示词随机性固有的错误。 表 2 也暴露了先前指标的缺陷：像 VideoScore 这样偏重感知的评估器对正向和负向人类控制样本打分几乎相同，而像 PQSG 和 RBench 这类面向动作的评估器总体相关性较低，因为其评分对物理合理性的下降不敏感。 附录 D.2 详细列出了完整的对齐结果，其中包括留出研究和……

paragraphs.en: To ground our fine-grained action analysis, we highlight recurring task and physics failure modes across model rollouts, where each error category corresponds to its matching color accent in Figure 11 , with an extended set of comprehensive samples provided in Appendix F .
paragraphs.zh: 为了为我们的细粒度动作分析提供依据，我们着重指出了模型 rollout 中反复出现的任务与物理失败模式，其中每个错误类别对应图 11 中与之匹配的颜色标注，附录 F 中提供了一组更全面的扩展示例。

paragraphs.en: Skipped prerequisites (a) recur when videos proceed to later operations, or cut directly to a completed state, without completing dependency actions. Models use capped objects, attempt insertion before opening containers, or pour before correctly orienting the receiving vessel.
paragraphs.zh: 跳过前置步骤的情况（a）会在视频直接进行后续操作、或直接切换到已完成状态而未完成依赖动作时反复出现。 模型会使用带盖的物体、在打开容器之前尝试插入，或在未正确对准接收容器之前进行倾倒。

sents.en: Skipped prerequisites (a) recur when videos proceed to later operations, or cut directly to a completed state, without completing dependency actions.
sents.zh: 跳过前置步骤的情况（a）会在视频直接进行后续操作、或直接切换到已完成状态而未完成依赖动作时反复出现。

sents.en: Models use capped objects, attempt insertion before opening containers, or pour before correctly orienting the receiving vessel.
sents.zh: 模型会使用带盖的物体、在打开容器之前尝试插入，或在未正确对准接收容器之前进行倾倒。

paragraphs.en: Incomplete outcomes (b) happens when models attempt an operation but fail to reach the intended final state. Objects remain partly outside containers, surface markings persist after wiping, or components not completely attached. Precision-sensitive actions also produce same errors, including misplaced lines, unequal partitions, and inaccurate pours.
paragraphs.zh: 不完整结果（b）发生在智能体尝试执行某项操作但未能达到预期的最终状态时。 物体部分留在容器外、表面擦拭后仍有痕迹，或部件未完全安装到位。 对精度敏感的操作也会产生同样的错误，包括画线位置错误、分割不均匀以及倾倒量不准确。

sents.en: Incomplete outcomes (b) happens when models attempt an operation but fail to reach the intended final state.
sents.zh: 不完整结果（b）发生在智能体尝试执行某项操作但未能达到预期的最终状态时。

sents.en: Objects remain partly outside containers, surface markings persist after wiping, or components not completely attached.
sents.zh: 物体部分留在容器外、表面擦拭后仍有痕迹，或部件未完全安装到位。

sents.en: Precision-sensitive actions also produce same errors, including misplaced lines, unequal partitions, and inaccurate pours.
sents.zh: 对精度敏感的操作也会产生同样的错误，包括画线位置错误、分割不均匀以及倾倒量不准确。

paragraphs.en: Domain-specific operations (c) involving less familiar objects or culturally specific artifacts often results incomplete outcomes. Models manipulate the relevant parts but fail to establish the relations needed for correct operation, suggesting limited understanding of how these objects function together.
paragraphs.zh: 涉及不太熟悉的物体或具有文化特定性的人工制品的领域特定操作往往会得到不完整的结果。 模型能够操纵相关的部分，但无法建立正确操作所需的关系，这表明模型对这些物体如何协同运作的理解有限。

paragraphs.en: Object inconsistencies (d) affect both object state and count. In terms of state, objects undergo unexplained changes in shape, material, identity, or assembly, sometimes transforming into different items. In terms of count, objects appear, disappear, duplicate, or merge without a corresponding process. A detached component may remain on its source while a duplicate appears in the hand, or overlapping objects may collapse into one.
paragraphs.zh: 物体不一致性 (d) 同时影响物体状态与数量。 在状态方面，物体会发生无法解释的形状、材质、身份或组装方式的变化，有时会转变成不同的物品。 在数量方面，物体会在没有对应过程的情况下出现、消失、复制或合并。 一个已分离的部件可能仍留在其来源物体上，而手中又出现一个副本，或者相互重叠的物体会合并为一个。

paragraphs.en: Boundary violations (e) occur when objects pass through closed lids or solid surfaces to reach their targets. This can follow an omitted opening step: the receiving container remains closed, yet the transfer proceeds.
paragraphs.zh: 边界违例（e）发生在物体穿过闭合的盖子或实体表面以到达其目标时。 这可能是由于省略了打开步骤：接收容器仍处于闭合状态，但转移却继续进行。

paragraphs.en: Mechanism violations (f) provide another form of invalid interaction. Articulated objects rotate about incorrect axes, coupled parts move independently, or rigid structures deform during opening.

paragraphs.en: We test sequential gating in two ways: by rescoring fixed pilot human annotations with recorded gate decisions, bypassing each gate or scoring all gates independently and comparing with holistic human ratings (Figure 5 ), and by rerunning Ego2ActJudge with independent gates (Appendix G ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过两种方式测试顺序门控：一是用记录的门控决策对固定的试点人工标注重新打分，即绕过每个门控或独立对所有门控打分，并与整体人工评分进行比较（图 5）；二是使用独立的门控重新运行 Ego2ActJudge（附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 5 , removing the primary physics continuity gate (P1) leads to a large error increase, while bypassing the task initiation gate (T1) similarly degrades alignment. Similar observations apply to other gates, though early crucial gating has the largest impact. Scoring all gates independently instead of sequentially also raises error, sharply for physics and slightly for task. The same holds inside Ego2ActJudge . Rerunning it with every gate asked independently inflates Final scores by 6.8 points and lowers Final r r from 0.69 to 0.65 and CCC from 0.62 to 0.51 (Appendix G ). Our key takeaway is that strict sequential gating makes fine-grained rubric scores more consistent with human judgment, and we expect it to help VLM judges (1) localize each sub-aspect of rubric evaluation and (2) explain each pass or exit decision.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 5 所示，移除主要的物理连续性门控（P1）会导致误差大幅增加，而绕过任务启动门控（T1）同样会使对齐性能下降。 对其他门控也有类似的观察结果，不过早期关键门控的影响最大。 将所有门控改为独立打分而非顺序打分也会增加误差，物理方面急剧上升，任务方面略有上升。 在 Ego2ActJudge 内部同样如此。 将其中每个门控改为独立询问重新运行后，Final 分数膨胀了 6.8 分，Final 的 r r 从 0.69 降至 0.65，CCC 从 0.62 降至 0.51（附录 G）。 我们的核心结论是，严格的顺序门控使细粒度评分标准的分数与人类判断更加一致，并且我们期望它能帮助 VLM 裁判（1）定位评分标准评估的每个子方面，以及（2）解释每个通过或退出的决定。

paragraphs.en: A VLM judge is only as perceptive as its backbone. Replacing Gemini-3.7-Flash (Flash) with GPT-5.6-Terra, all other settings fixed, keeps the judge aligned with humans but less closely, and case-level cross-validation also favors Flash (Table 4 , Appendix D.2 ). However, controlled physics corruptions of real recordings show that the judge often catches violations visible within a frame, such as an object that duplicates or changes identity, but largely misses those that unfold between frames, such as short temporal jumps. Its Physics scores are therefore best read as optimistic, structured gating and backbone choice both shape agreement, and the most direct path to a stronger judge is denser temporal evidence (Appendix G ).
paragraphs.zh: VLM 评判器的感知能力取决于其底层模型。 在保持其他设置不变的情况下，将 Gemini-3.7-Flash（Flash）替换为 GPT-5.6-Terra，评判器仍与人类保持一致，但一致性程度有所下降，且案例级别的交叉验证也更倾向于 Flash（表 4，附录 D.2）。 然而，对真实录制内容进行受控物理破坏的实验表明，评判器通常能够捕捉到单帧内可见的违规现象，例如物体复制或身份改变，但在很大程度上会漏掉跨帧展开的违规现象，例如短时的时间跳跃。 因此，其 Physics 分数最好被解读为偏乐观的；结构化门控与底层模型的选择都会影响一致性，而获得更强评判器的最直接途径是提供更密集的时间维度证据（附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: We present Ego2Act and Ego2ActJudge to evaluate whether generative video models are able to generate goal-directed egocentric manipulation rollouts that complete the task with plausible physics. Addressing RQ1 ( Faithful egocentric task execution ), our benchmark across six video generators, 110 real-world cases, and 2,640 total videos reveals a substantial human-AI gap: the top model scores only 64.0 under human evaluation of a 25-case panel, while open-weight models drop as low as 3.9, failing most severely during fine-grained, state-modifying contact dynamics like attachment and material transfer. Addressing RQ2 ( Reliable & scalable evaluation ), Ego2ActJudge provides a reference-free, rubric-derived pipeline that achieves a Pearson correlation of r = 0.69 r=0.69 with human consensus. Conclusively, Ego2Act demonstrates that modern video generators struggle to align physical accuracy with complete task execution, underscoring the need for future world model building that is able to (1) execute every required step rather than omitting prerequisite states or leaving actions incomplete, (2) maintain persistent object identity and state under dynamic egocentric motion and frequent hand occlusions, and (3) ground contact-rich interactions in physically plausible dynamics to serve as reliable simulators for embodied planning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Ego2Act 和 Ego2ActJudge，以评估生成式视频模型能否生成符合目标导向、物理合理的自我中心操作推演，从而完成任务。 针对 RQ1（忠实的自我中心任务执行），我们的基准测试覆盖六个视频生成器、110 个真实世界案例和总计 2,640 个视频，揭示了显著的人机差距：在 25 个案例组成的小组的人工评估下，表现最好的模型仅得 64.0 分，而开放权重模型的得分低至 3.9，在最需要精细操作的状态改变型接触动态（如附着和物质转移）中失败最为严重。 针对 RQ2（可靠且可扩展的评估），Ego2ActJudge 提供了一种免参考、基于评分准则的评估流程，与人类共识达到了 r = 0.69 的皮尔逊相关系数。 总而言之，Ego2Act 表明现代视频生成器难以在物理准确性与完整任务执行之间取得一致，这凸显了未来构建世界模型的需求：该模型能够 (1) 执行每一个必需步骤，而不是省略前置状态或使动作不完整，(2) 在动态的自我中心运动和频繁的手部遮挡下保持物体身份和状态的持久性，(3) 将富含接触的交互建立在物理合理的动力学之上，从而成为可靠的具身规划模拟器。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we used generative AI tools for method implementation (coding assistants helped write and edit the evaluation and analysis code), dataset reformatting (consolidating evaluator outputs into analysis tables), and qualitative data analysis support (drafting the per-recording metadata of observed sub-actions, involved objects, and action types, which annotators then checked and corrected). We have not used generative AI tools for synthetic dataset generation, theoretical or conceptual framework development, mathematical claims, proofs, hypothesis proposal or refinement, research methodology or experiment design feedback, translation, or result interpretation. Additionally, we used generative AI tools for figure creation (plotting code for the dataset-statistics figure), readability editing and structure suggestions for the manuscript, and reference formatting. We have reviewed all AI-assisted work: all reported numbers are reproduced by the released analysis scripts from the stored evaluator outputs and human annotations, AI-drafted metadata was checked against the recordings, and all text was reviewed and edited by the authors. We take responsibility for the final content of this work, including text, claims or artifacts produced with the aid of generative AI.

paragraphs.en: We document every component needed to reproduce our results. Appendix A.1 gives the task-construction and verification criteria, and Appendix A.4 gives the exact prompt, seeds, and settings used to generate every video, with the models and durations in Section 5.1 . Appendix B gives the full human Task and Physics rubrics, including the gate definitions and the handling of unattempted and unobservable subgoals. Appendix B.5 specifies the Ego2ActJudge backbone, decoding and frame-sampling settings, pseudocode, and all prompts verbatim (Appendix B.6 ). Appendix C.1 specifies how each baseline’s outputs are mapped to Task and Physics scores, and Appendix C.2 lists every change made to run the baselines, including the Simple VQA and adapted RBench prompts. Appendix D describes the human-annotation protocol, including annotator calibration, and the agreement and alignment metrics. All reported tables and figures are computed by analysis scripts from the stored per-video judge outputs, baseline outputs, and human ratings, without additional model calls. We will release the benchmark (initial scenes, goals, human recordings, and generated videos), the Ego2ActJudge code and prompts, the human annotations and rubric guidelines, and the analysis scripts upon publication.

paragraphs.en: Ego2Act contains egocentric recordings made by nine annotators in everyday indoor settings, which show the annotators’ hands and household objects from a first-person view, together with videos generated from these scenes through the model providers’ interfaces. All annotators gave informed consent to the recording, annotation, and release of their recordings. The three raters in the human study scored anonymized videos without knowing which model produced them. We remove location and device metadata from released images and videos, and the recordings are intended to contain no faces or other personally identifying content. Ego2Act and Ego2ActJudge evaluate existing video models, and we release no new generator. Realistic manipulation videos could be misused to depict events that did not happen, and a stricter judge of physical plausibility could make such videos harder to detect, so we release the benchmark and evaluator for research use.
paragraphs.zh: Ego2Act 包含由九名标注者在日常室内环境中录制的第一视角记录，这些记录从第一人称视角展示了标注者的双手和家居物品，同时包含通过模型提供方接口根据这些场景生成的视频。 所有标注者均对录制、标注及发布其录像给予了知情同意。 人类研究中的三名评分者对匿名化后的视频进行评分，且不知道视频由哪个模型生成。 我们从发布的图像和视频中移除了位置和设备元数据，且这些录制内容旨在不包含人脸或其他可识别个人身份的内容。 Ego2Act 和 Ego2ActJudge 评估的是现有视频模型，我们不发布任何新的生成器。 逼真的操作视频可能被滥用于描绘并未真实发生的事件，而更严格的物理合理性评判可能会使此类视频更难被检测，因此我们将该基准和评估器仅用于研究用途发布。

sents.en: Ego2Act contains egocentric recordings made by nine annotators in everyday indoor settings, which show the annotators’ hands and household objects from a first-person view, together with videos generated from these scenes through the model providers’ interfaces.
sents.zh: Ego2Act 包含由九名标注者在日常室内环境中录制的第一视角记录，这些记录从第一人称视角展示了标注者的双手和家居物品，同时包含通过模型提供方接口根据这些场景生成的视频。

sents.en: All annotators gave informed consent to the recording, annotation, and release of their recordings.
sents.zh: 所有标注者均对录制、标注及发布其录像给予了知情同意。

sents.en: The three raters in the human study scored anonymized videos without knowing which model produced them.
sents.zh: 人类研究中的三名评分者对匿名化后的视频进行评分，且不知道视频由哪个模型生成。

sents.en: We remove location and device metadata from released images and videos, and the recordings are intended to contain no faces or other personally identifying content.
sents.zh: 我们从发布的图像和视频中移除了位置和设备元数据，且这些录制内容旨在不包含人脸或其他可识别个人身份的内容。

sents.en: Ego2Act and Ego2ActJudge evaluate existing video models, and we release no new generator.
sents.zh: Ego2Act 和 Ego2ActJudge 评估的是现有视频模型，我们不发布任何新的生成器。

sents.en: Realistic manipulation videos could be misused to depict events that did not happen, and a stricter judge of physical plausibility could make such videos harder to detect, so we release the benchmark and evaluator for research use.
sents.zh: 逼真的操作视频可能被滥用于描绘并未真实发生的事件，而更严格的物理合理性评判可能会使此类视频更难被检测，因此我们将该基准和评估器仅用于研究用途发布。

paragraphs.en: We apply the following rubric to every proposed case. A case must satisfy all task-construction and visual-verification requirements before inclusion in the benchmark. Cases that fail a requirement are revised or removed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对每个提出的案例应用以下评估标准。 案例必须满足所有任务构建和视觉验证要求，才能纳入基准。 未满足要求的案例将被修改或移除。

sents.zh: 案例必须满足所有任务构建和视觉验证要求，才能纳入基准。

sents.en: Cases that fail a requirement are revised or removed.
sents.zh: 未满足要求的案例将被修改或移除。

paragraphs.en: Each Ego2Act case consists of an initial scene, a goal, six human recordings, and the eighteen videos generated from that scene, together with features that describe the task. Table 5 details the types and definitions of these features, and Figure 2 visualizes their distribution throughout the benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 每个 Ego2Act 案例由一个初始场景、一个目标、六段人类录像，以及由该场景生成的十八个视频组成，同时包含描述任务的特征。 表 5 详细列出了这些特征的类型和定义，图 2 则可视化了它们在整个基准中的分布情况。

paragraphs.en: Every case belongs to one of five everyday domains. The domain is determined by the primary objects involved in the task. For example, storing a toothbrush and toothpaste in a travel case falls under Personal Care and Utilities. Table 6 defines each domain and lists the objects that appear in its cases.

paragraphs.en: Annotators begin by manually assigning the domain, clutter level, and task-relevant objects for each case. To generate the remaining features, such as step counts and trajectory descriptions, we prompt a vision-language model (VLM) to analyze frames sampled from successful recordings.
paragraphs.zh: 标注人员首先为每个案例手动指定领域、杂乱程度以及与任务相关的物体。 为了生成其余特征（如步数和轨迹描述），我们提示一个视觉语言模型（VLM）分析从成功录制中采样的帧。

paragraphs.en: The initial scene is resized to 512 pixels on its longer side with the aspect ratio preserved, and the same resized image is given to the video models and to Ego2ActJudge . Human recordings are captured as MP4 or MOV files. Both the human recordings and the generated videos are resized to 480p, that is, at most 854 × 480 854\times 480 pixels, and the baseline evaluators receive them as H.264 MP4 files at no more than 24 fps. Ego2ActJudge instead samples frames from each video and resizes every frame to 512 pixels on its longer side (Appendix B.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 初始场景在保持宽高比的情况下被缩放至长边 512 像素，并将同一张缩放后的图像同时提供给视频模型和 Ego2ActJudge。 人类录制视频以 MP4 或 MOV 文件格式采集。 人类录制视频和生成的视频均被缩放至 480p，即最多 854 × 480 854\times 480 像素，基线评估器接收的是不超过 24 fps 的 H.264 MP4 文件。 Ego2ActJudge 则从每个视频中采样帧，并将每一帧缩放至长边 512 像素（附录 B.5）。

paragraphs.en: A step is a purposeful operation that is visible in a recording, such as moving an object, opening a lid, or pouring, and a single motion that carries two objects together counts as one step. The trajectory description lists these steps with their approximate times, and the number of steps counts them. Because both describe how one recording was executed, the number of steps can vary across the three successful recordings of a case and does not measure the minimum number of subgoals that the goal requires. The object list is provided by the annotator as part of the case, whereas the involved objects are the solid objects actually handled in the successful recordings, together with objects that receive another object, such as a container. Objects that are never used are not counted as involved objects, which keeps the object count separate from the clutter level.
paragraphs.zh: 步骤是在录像中可见的有目的的操作，例如移动物体、打开盖子或倾倒，一次将两个物体一起带动完成的动作算作一个步骤。 轨迹描述按大致时间列出这些步骤，步骤数就是对它们进行计数的结果。 由于两者都描述了同一录像的执行方式，步骤数在同一个案例的三次成功录像之间可能不同，因此它并不能衡量该目标所需子目标的最小数量。 物体列表由标注者作为案例的一部分提供，而涉及物体则是成功录像中实际被操作的实体物体，以及接收其他物体的物体，例如容器。 从未使用的物体不计入涉及物体，这使得物体数量与杂乱程度相互独立。

paragraphs.en: Each action type belongs to one of the nine action families defined in Table 7 , and a case covers the families of all of its action types. For example, a case in which the recordings attach a ball to a stick, stand the stick upright, and stack two cans covers attachment and connection (A4), shape and orientation change (A5), and relocation and arrangement (A1). Figure 2 b shows how often two families appear in the same case, and Figure 2 f counts the distinct families per case.
paragraphs.zh: 每种动作类型都属于表 7 中定义的九个动作族之一，而一个案例涵盖其所有动作类型所属的动作族。 例如，一个案例中包含将球固定到棍子上、将棍子竖立起来以及堆叠两个罐子的记录，该案例涵盖了附着与连接（A4）、形状与朝向改变（A5）以及移位与排列（A1）。 图 2 b 展示了两个动作族在同一案例中同时出现的频率，图 2 f 统计了每个案例中不同动作族的数量。

paragraphs.en: The data are collected by nine annotators. Each annotator is assigned one of the five task categories and proposes cases within it, capturing the initial scene for each proposed case. Before collection, annotators receive an illustrated guideline that explains every requirement of the rubric in Appendix A.1 with accepted and rejected example scenes and goals. Every proposed case is checked against the rubric, and cases that violate any requirement are revised or discarded. Clutter is left to the annotator’s discretion during capture and is labeled afterwards as none, minimal, or heavy according to the amount of task-irrelevant content visible in the initial scene.
paragraphs.zh: 数据由九名标注者收集。 每位标注者被分配五个任务类别之一，并在其中提出案例，同时为每个提出的案例捕捉初始场景。 在收集之前，标注者会收到一份图文指南，其中结合被接受和被拒绝的示例场景与目标，解释了附录 A.1 中评估标准的每一项要求。 每个提出的案例都会依据评估标准进行检查，违反任何要求的案例会被修改或舍弃。 在捕捉场景时，杂乱程度由标注者自行决定，之后根据初始场景中可见的与任务无关内容的数量，将其标注为无、少量或大量。

sents.zh: 数据由九名标注者收集。

sents.en: Clutter is left to the annotator’s discretion during capture and is labeled afterwards as none, minimal, or heavy according to the amount of task-irrelevant content visible in the initial scene.
sents.zh: 在捕捉场景时，杂乱程度由标注者自行决定，之后根据初始场景中可见的与任务无关内容的数量，将其标注为无、少量或大量。

paragraphs.en: For each case, the annotator records three successful and three unsuccessful attempts from the initial scene, following the visual verification requirements. All recordings are captured by the human annotators themselves from a first-person viewpoint that matches the initial scene image, with one hand performing the task. Successful attempts must differ in at least one structural dimension (sub-action ordering, resource or tool selection, or intermediate state transitions). Unsuccessful attempts serve as negative controls, leaving the goal unmet while keeping human motion physically natural, which lets us test whether an evaluator separates task failure from physical implausibility. All the recordings of a case start from the state shown in the initial scene and keep the same first-person viewpoint and orientation. Each recording must also be sufficiently bright and respect the closed-world constraint. Objects may temporarily leave the view as the hand moves or the camera shifts, but no task-relevant object that is absent from the initial scene may be introduced.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个案例，标注者根据视觉验证要求，从初始场景开始记录三次成功尝试和三次失败尝试。 所有录制均由人类标注者亲自完成，采用与初始场景图像一致的第一人称视角，用单手执行任务。 成功尝试必须在至少一个结构维度上有所不同（子动作顺序、资源或工具选择，或中间状态转换）。 失败尝试作为负对照，在保持人类动作物理自然的前提下使目标未被达成，这使我们能够测试评估器能否将任务失败与物理不合理性区分开来。 每个案例的所有录制都从初始场景所示的状态开始，并保持相同的第一人称视角和朝向。 每段录制还必须光照充足，并遵守封闭世界约束。 随着手部移动或相机偏移，物体可能暂时离开视野，但不得引入任何初始场景中不存在的与任务相关的物体。

sents.en: For each case, the annotator records three successful and three unsuccessful attempts from the initial scene, following the visual verification requirements.
sents.zh: 对于每个案例，标注者根据视觉验证要求，从初始场景开始记录三次成功尝试和三次失败尝试。

sents.en: All recordings are captured by the human annotators themselves from a first-person viewpoint that matches the initial scene image, with one hand performing the task.
sents.zh: 所有录制均由人类标注者亲自完成，采用与初始场景图像一致的第一人称视角，用单手执行任务。

sents.en: Successful attempts must differ in at least one structural dimension (sub-action ordering, resource or tool selection, or intermediate state transitions).
sents.zh: 成功尝试必须在至少一个结构维度上有所不同（子动作顺序、资源或工具选择，或中间状态转换）。

sents.en: Unsuccessful attempts serve as negative controls, leaving the goal unmet while keeping human motion physically natural, which lets us test whether an evaluator separates task failure from physical implausibility.
sents.zh: 失败尝试作为负对照，在保持人类动作物理自然的前提下使目标未被达成，这使我们能够测试评估器能否将任务失败与物理不合理性区分开来。

sents.en: All the recordings of a case start from the state shown in the initial scene and keep the same first-person viewpoint and orientation.
sents.zh: 每个案例的所有录制都从初始场景所示的状态开始，并保持相同的第一人称视角和朝向。

sents.en: Each recording must also be sufficiently bright and respect the closed-world constraint.
sents.zh: 每段录制还必须光照充足，并遵守封闭世界约束。

sents.en: Objects may temporarily leave the view as the hand moves or the camera shifts, but no task-relevant object that is absent from the initial scene may be introduced.

paragraphs.en: For every human recording, a vision-language model drafts and annotators then check and correct (1) a high-level description of the attempted trajectory, (2) the number of observed sub-actions, (3) the video duration, (4) the task-relevant objects, (5) their distinguishing attributes (e.g., color), and (6) the action types involved. Action types are grouped into the nine action families shown in Figure 2 b. These annotations describe the recorded executions only and are never used as ground-truth subgoal decompositions during evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每段人类录像，视觉-语言模型先起草标注，标注员随后检查并修正：（1）所尝试轨迹的高层描述，（2）观察到的子动作数量，（3）视频时长，（4）与任务相关的物体，（5）它们的区分属性（例如颜色），以及（6）所涉及的动作类型。 动作类型被归入图 2 b 所示的九个动作族。 这些标注仅描述所记录的执行过程，绝不会在评估中作为真值子目标分解使用。

sents.en: For every human recording, a vision-language model drafts and annotators then check and correct (1) a high-level description of the attempted trajectory, (2) the number of observed sub-actions, (3) the video duration, (4) the task-relevant objects, (5) their distinguishing attributes (e.g., color), and (6) the action types involved.
sents.zh: 对于每段人类录像，视觉-语言模型先起草标注，标注员随后检查并修正：（1）所尝试轨迹的高层描述，（2）观察到的子动作数量，（3）视频时长，（4）与任务相关的物体，（5）它们的区分属性（例如颜色），以及（6）所涉及的动作类型。

sents.en: Action types are grouped into the nine action families shown in Figure 2 b.
sents.zh: 动作类型被归入图 2 b 所示的九个动作族。

sents.en: These annotations describe the recorded executions only and are never used as ground-truth subgoal decompositions during evaluation.
sents.zh: 这些标注仅描述所记录的执行过程，绝不会在评估中作为真值子目标分解使用。

paragraphs.en: Before inclusion, a second annotator reviews every case against the rubric in Appendix A.1 , and compliance with each requirement is recorded as a per-case checklist. The second annotator checks the goal for clarity, feasibility, duplication with existing cases, and the accuracy of its metadata, including domain and clutter labels. Each recording is also inspected for visual quality, viewpoint consistency, and compliance with the closed-world constraint, and confirmed to support its designation as a successful or unsuccessful attempt. Cases that fail a requirement are returned for revision or removed.
paragraphs.zh: 在纳入之前，由第二位标注者根据附录 A.1 中的标准对每个案例进行复核，并将每项要求的符合情况记录为逐案例清单。 第二位标注者检查目标的清晰度、可行性、与现有案例的重复情况，以及其元数据（包括领域和杂乱标签）的准确性。 每个录制内容还会被检查视觉质量、视角一致性以及对封闭世界约束的符合情况，并确认其支持被指定为成功或不成功的尝试。 未通过某项要求的案例会被退回修改或删除。

sents.en: Before inclusion, a second annotator reviews every case against the rubric in Appendix A.1 , and compliance with each requirement is recorded as a per-case checklist.
sents.zh: 在纳入之前，由第二位标注者根据附录 A.1 中的标准对每个案例进行复核，并将每项要求的符合情况记录为逐案例清单。

sents.en: The second annotator checks the goal for clarity, feasibility, duplication with existing cases, and the accuracy of its metadata, including domain and clutter labels.
sents.zh: 第二位标注者检查目标的清晰度、可行性、与现有案例的重复情况，以及其元数据（包括领域和杂乱标签）的准确性。

sents.en: Each recording is also inspected for visual quality, viewpoint consistency, and compliance with the closed-world constraint, and confirmed to support its designation as a successful or unsuccessful attempt.
sents.zh: 每个录制内容还会被检查视觉质量、视角一致性以及对封闭世界约束的符合情况，并确认其支持被指定为成功或不成功的尝试。

sents.en: Cases that fail a requirement are returned for revision or removed.
sents.zh: 未通过某项要求的案例会被退回修改或删除。

Each model generates three videos per case with seeds 101, 202, and 303, where the provider supports seeds, at 480p and the maximum duration listed in Section 5.1 . paragraphs.en: Each generated video is evaluated against the initial egocentric scene, the task goal, and the associated subgoal decomposition. Evaluation is reference free: raters do not compare the video with a canonical execution. The rubric separates task completion from physical plausibility, since a video may satisfy the goal while containing physically implausible interactions, or exhibit plausible interactions while failing to complete the task.
paragraphs.zh: 每个生成的视频都会根据初始的第一人称视角场景、任务目标以及相关的子目标分解进行评估。 评估是无参考的：评分者不会将视频与标准执行过程进行比较。 该评估准则将任务完成度与物理合理性分开，因为一个视频可能在不满足物理合理交互的情况下仍达成目标，或者交互合理但未能完成任务。

paragraphs.en: This section details the rubrics summarized in Section 4 . It condenses the illustrated annotation guidelines given to human raters, the Task Completion rubric and the Physical Aspects rubric, which will be released with the benchmark. We distinguish their annotation guidance from the judge’s operational interpretation where necessary. Appendix B.5 specifies the executable procedure, evidence tools, and unavailable-output policy.
paragraphs.zh: 本节详细阐述第 4 节中总结的评分标准。 它浓缩了提供给人类评分者的图示标注指南、任务完成（Task Completion）评分标准和物理表现（Physical Aspects）评分标准，这些内容将随基准一起发布。 我们在必要处将二者的标注指导与裁判的可操作解释区分开来。 附录 B.5 规定了可执行的流程、证据工具以及不可用输出的处理政策。

paragraphs.en: Given a goal G G , annotators first decompose it into N N atomic subgoals { S 1 , … , S N } \{S_{1},\ldots,S_{N}\} . Each subgoal contains one source object, at most one target, and one principal action. For each subgoal S i S_{i} , annotators check three gates in order and stop at the first gate that fails (early exit):
paragraphs.zh: 给定一个目标 G G，标注者首先将其分解为 N N 个原子子目标 { S 1 , … , S N } \{S_{1},\ldots,S_{N}\}。 每个子目标包含一个源对象、至多一个目标对象以及一个主要动作。 对于每个子目标 S i S_{i}，标注者按顺序检查三个门控，并在第一个未通过的门控处停止（提前退出）：

sents.en: Given a goal G G , annotators first decompose it into N N atomic subgoals { S 1 , … , S N } \{S_{1},\ldots,S_{N}\} .
sents.zh: 给定一个目标 G G，标注者首先将其分解为 N N 个原子子目标 { S 1 , … , S N } \{S_{1},\ldots,S_{N}\}。

sents.en: Each subgoal contains one source object, at most one target, and one principal action.
sents.zh: 每个子目标包含一个源对象、至多一个目标对象以及一个主要动作。

sents.en: For each subgoal S i S_{i} , annotators check three gates in order and stop at the first gate that fails (early exit):
sents.zh: 对于每个子目标 S i S_{i}，标注者按顺序检查三个门控，并在第一个未通过的门控处停止（提前退出）：

paragraphs.en: T1 Intent. Is there visible task-directed behavior involving the correct object, tool, or mechanism? If not, t i = 0 t_{i}=0 .
paragraphs.zh: T1 意图。 是否存在涉及正确对象、工具或机制的可见任务导向行为？ 如果没有，则 t i = 0 t_{i}=0。

sents.en: T1 Intent.
sents.zh: T1 意图。

sents.en: Is there visible task-directed behavior involving the correct object, tool, or mechanism?
sents.zh: 是否存在涉及正确对象、工具或机制的可见任务导向行为？

sents.en: If not, t i = 0 t_{i}=0 .
sents.zh: 如果没有，则 t i = 0 t_{i}=0。

paragraphs.en: T2 Process. Is the intended action carried out as a recognizable high-level trajectory from initiation to completion? If not, t i = 1 t_{i}=1 .
paragraphs.zh: T2 过程。 预期动作是否作为一条从启动到完成、可识别的高层轨迹被执行？ 如果不是，则 t i = 1 t_{i}=1。

sents.en: T2 Process.
sents.zh: T2 过程。

sents.en: Is the intended action carried out as a recognizable high-level trajectory from initiation to completion?
sents.zh: 预期动作是否作为一条从启动到完成、可识别的高层轨迹被执行？

sents.en: If not, t i = 1 t_{i}=1 .
sents.zh: 如果不是，则 t i = 1 t_{i}=1。

paragraphs.en: T3 Final state. Does the subgoal end in the state specified by the goal? If not, t i = 2 t_{i}=2 , and otherwise t i = 3 t_{i}=3 .
paragraphs.zh: T3 终态。 子目标是否终结于目标所指定的状态？ 如果不是，则 t i = 2 t_{i}=2 ，否则 t i = 3 t_{i}=3 。

sents.en: T3 Final state.
sents.zh: T3 终态。

sents.en: Does the subgoal end in the state specified by the goal?
sents.zh: 子目标是否终结于目标所指定的状态？

sents.en: If not, t i = 2 t_{i}=2 , and otherwise t i = 3 t_{i}=3 .
sents.zh: 如果不是，则 t i = 2 t_{i}=2 ，否则 t i = 3 t_{i}=3 。

paragraphs.en: The subgoal score therefore counts the gates passed before the first failure,
paragraphs.zh: 因此，子目标分数统计的是在第一次失败之前通过的关卡数量，

paragraphs.en: so a later gate is never checked once an earlier one fails.
paragraphs.zh: 所以一旦前面的门未通过，后面的门就不会再被检查。

paragraphs.en: The base task score is the mean of the subgoal scores,
paragraphs.zh: 基础任务分数是各子目标分数的平均值，

paragraphs.en: The final task score is T = t base T=t_{\mathrm{base}} , with no separate ordering penalty. Rendering artifacts are ignored unless they prevent the intent, process, or final state from being established.
paragraphs.zh: 最终任务得分为 T = t_base，不单独施加排序惩罚。 除非渲染瑕疵影响意图、过程或最终状态的判定，否则予以忽略。

sents.en: The final task score is T = t base T=t_{\mathrm{base}} , with no separate ordering penalty.
sents.zh: 最终任务得分为 T = t_base，不单独施加排序惩罚。

sents.en: Rendering artifacts are ignored unless they prevent the intent, process, or final state from being established.
sents.zh: 除非渲染瑕疵影响意图、过程或最终状态的判定，否则予以忽略。

paragraphs.en: Each subgoal describes one source entity, at most one target, and one high-level action. For example, putting a fork and a spoon on a tray is split into two placement subgoals. Reaching, grasping, carrying, and releasing are not separate requested outcomes of a single placement. Necessary enabling actions, such as opening a closed container before insertion, are represented as their own subgoals, so omitting them lowers the score through t i = 0 t_{i}=0 . Independent placements need not follow a fixed order.
paragraphs.zh: 每个子目标描述一个源实体、至多一个目标以及一个高层动作。 例如，把叉子和勺子放到托盘上会被拆分为两个放置子目标。 抓取、抓握、搬运和释放并不是单个放置的独立请求结果。 必要的使能动作（例如在插入前先打开一个关闭的容器）会作为独立的子目标表示，因此遗漏它们会通过 t i = 0 t_{i}=0 降低得分。 相互独立的放置无需遵循固定的顺序。

sents.en: Each subgoal describes one source entity, at most one target, and one high-level action.
sents.zh: 每个子目标描述一个源实体、至多一个目标以及一个高层动作。

sents.en: For example, putting a fork and a spoon on a tray is split into two placement subgoals.
sents.zh: 例如，把叉子和勺子放到托盘上会被拆分为两个放置子目标。

sents.en: Reaching, grasping, carrying, and releasing are not separate requested outcomes of a single placement.
sents.zh: 抓取、抓握、搬运和释放并不是单个放置的独立请求结果。

sents.en: Necessary enabling actions, such as opening a closed container before insertion, are represented as their own subgoals, so omitting them lowers the score through t i = 0 t_{i}=0 .
sents.zh: 必要的使能动作（例如在插入前先打开一个关闭的容器）会作为独立的子目标表示，因此遗漏它们会通过 t i = 0 t_{i}=0 降低得分。

sents.en: Independent placements need not follow a fixed order.
sents.zh: 相互独立的放置无需遵循固定的顺序。

paragraphs.en: T1–T3 name the gates, that is, the questions. The subgoal level t i ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 } t_{i}\in\{0,1,2,3\} counts the gates passed, so t i = 0 t_{i}=0 means T1 failed and t i = 3 t_{i}=3 means all three passed. Appendices E.3 and F.1 abbreviate level k k as T k k (Task) or P k k (Physics).
paragraphs.zh: T1–T3 命名了各个关卡，即各个问题。 子目标层级 t i ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 } t_{i}\in\{0,1,2,3\} 统计已通过的关卡数，因此 t i = 0 t_{i}=0 表示 T1 未通过，而 t i = 3 t_{i}=3 表示三个关卡全部通过。 附录 E.3 和 F.1 将层级 k k 缩写为 T k k（Task，任务）或 P k k（Physics，物理）。

sents.en: T1–T3 name the gates, that is, the questions.
sents.zh: T1–T3 命名了各个关卡，即各个问题。

sents.en: The subgoal level t i ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 } t_{i}\in\{0,1,2,3\} counts the gates passed, so t i = 0 t_{i}=0 means T1 failed and t i = 3 t_{i}=3 means all three passed.
sents.zh: 子目标层级 t i ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 } t_{i}\in\{0,1,2,3\} 统计已通过的关卡数，因此 t i = 0 t_{i}=0 表示 T1 未通过，而 t i = 3 t_{i}=3 表示三个关卡全部通过。

sents.en: Appendices E.3 and F.1 abbreviate level k k as T k k (Task) or P k k (Physics).
sents.zh: 附录 E.3 和 F.1 将层级 k k 缩写为 T k k（Task，任务）或 P k k（Physics，物理）。

paragraphs.en: Determine whether task-directed behavior toward the correct source object, tool, or mechanism has begun. A directed reach or pre-grasp can pass, whereas remaining still, moving away, or acting only on the wrong source fails. Failure here gives t i = 0 t_{i}=0 . This gate concerns the observable attempt, not whether the object is successfully grasped or the goal is eventually achieved.
paragraphs.zh: 判断针对正确来源对象、工具或机制的任务导向行为是否已经出现。 有方向的伸手或预抓取动作可以通过，而保持静止、移开或只作用于错误来源则不通过。 此处失败则 t i = 0 t_{i}=0 。 该判定关注可观察的尝试行为，而不涉及对象是否被成功抓取或目标是否最终达成。

sents.en: Determine whether task-directed behavior toward the correct source object, tool, or mechanism has begun.
sents.zh: 判断针对正确来源对象、工具或机制的任务导向行为是否已经出现。

sents.en: A directed reach or pre-grasp can pass, whereas remaining still, moving away, or acting only on the wrong source fails.
sents.zh: 有方向的伸手或预抓取动作可以通过，而保持静止、移开或只作用于错误来源则不通过。

sents.en: Failure here gives t i = 0 t_{i}=0 .
sents.zh: 此处失败则 t i = 0 t_{i}=0 。

sents.en: This gate concerns the observable attempt, not whether the object is successfully grasped or the goal is eventually achieved.
sents.zh: 该判定关注可观察的尝试行为，而不涉及对象是否被成功抓取或目标是否最终达成。

paragraphs.en: If T1 passes, determine whether the characteristic action—such as carrying, pouring, wiping, or turning—is substantially performed from beginning to end. Setup alone is insufficient. A small preparatory twist followed by withdrawal, an aborted transfer, or motion wholly away from the required action fails, giving t i = 1 t_{i}=1 . Precise success of the resulting relation is reserved for T3.
paragraphs.zh: 如果 T1 通过，则判断该特征动作——例如搬运、倾倒、擦拭或转动——是否从头到尾被实质性完成。 仅有准备动作是不够的。 小幅预备性转动后随即撤回、中途放弃的转移，或完全背离所需动作的运动都算失败，给出 t i = 1 t_{i}=1 。 所产生关系的精确成功留待 T3 判断。

sents.en: If T1 passes, determine whether the characteristic action—such as carrying, pouring, wiping, or turning—is substantially performed from beginning to end.
sents.zh: 如果 T1 通过，则判断该特征动作——例如搬运、倾倒、擦拭或转动——是否从头到尾被实质性完成。

sents.en: Setup alone is insufficient.
sents.zh: 仅有准备动作是不够的。

sents.en: A small preparatory twist followed by withdrawal, an aborted transfer, or motion wholly away from the required action fails, giving t i = 1 t_{i}=1 .
sents.zh: 小幅预备性转动后随即撤回、中途放弃的转移，或完全背离所需动作的运动都算失败，给出 t i = 1 t_{i}=1 。

sents.en: Precise success of the resulting relation is reserved for T3.
sents.zh: 所产生关系的精确成功留待 T3 判断。

paragraphs.en: If T1 and T2 pass, inspect the post-action evidence for the position, relation, or state specified by the subgoal. An object placed beside rather than inside its target, a barely opened drawer when opening is required, or a visibly incorrect fill amount fails, giving t i = 2 t_{i}=2 . Passing all three gates gives t i = 3 t_{i}=3 . The required outcome must be visible, because apparent intent alone cannot establish it. The rubric’s example of a half-filled container accepts roughly 45–55% and rejects 70%, but this is an illustrative tolerance, not a universal numerical threshold for all tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 如果 T1 和 T2 通过，则检查该智能体动作之后与子目标所指定的位置、关系或状态相关的证据。 物体被放在目标旁边而非内部、需要打开的抽屉仅被微微拉开，或明显不正确的填充量均判为失败，给出 t i = 2 t_{i}=2 。 通过全部三项判定则给出 t i = 3 t_{i}=3 。 所需结果必须可见，因为仅凭表面上的意图无法确立该结果。 评分标准中半满容器的示例接受大约 45–55% 并拒绝 70%，但这只是一个说明性的容差，并非适用于所有任务的通用数值阈值。

sents.en: If T1 and T2 pass, inspect the post-action evidence for the position, relation, or state specified by the subgoal.
sents.zh: 如果 T1 和 T2 通过，则检查该智能体动作之后与子目标所指定的位置、关系或状态相关的证据。

sents.en: An object placed beside rather than inside its target, a barely opened drawer when opening is required, or a visibly incorrect fill amount fails, giving t i = 2 t_{i}=2 .
sents.zh: 物体被放在目标旁边而非内部、需要打开的抽屉仅被微微拉开，或明显不正确的填充量均判为失败，给出 t i = 2 t_{i}=2 。

sents.en: Passing all three gates gives t i = 3 t_{i}=3 .
sents.zh: 通过全部三项判定则给出 t i = 3 t_{i}=3 。

sents.en: The required outcome must be visible, because apparent intent alone cannot establish it.
sents.zh: 所需结果必须可见，因为仅凭表面上的意图无法确立该结果。

sents.en: The rubric’s example of a half-filled container accepts roughly 45–55% and rejects 70%, but this is an illustrative tolerance, not a universal numerical threshold for all tasks.
sents.zh: 评分标准中半满容器的示例接受大约 45–55% 并拒绝 70%，但这只是一个说明性的容差，并非适用于所有任务的通用数值阈值。

paragraphs.en: Malformed hands, clipping, floating, or appearance flicker do not independently fail a Task gate when the relevant attempt, process, or result remains verifiable. The rubric even permits Task process credit for its illustrated snapping transfer, while assigning the discontinuity to Physics. A defect matters to Task when it destroys or contradicts the evidence required by that gate. Consequently, a physically impossible execution can receive Task credit, and a physically coherent wrong-object action can fail Task.
paragraphs.zh: 当相关的尝试、过程或结果仍然可验证时，手部畸形、穿模、悬空或外观闪烁不会单独导致任务（Task）关卡不通过。 该评分规则甚至允许为其图示的贴合转移行为给予任务过程分，同时将这种不连续性归入物理（Physics）维度。 当缺陷破坏或与该关卡所需的证据相矛盾时，该缺陷才会对任务产生影响。 因此，物理上不可能的执行可以获得任务分，而物理上连贯的错误对象动作可能在任务上不通过。

sents.en: Malformed hands, clipping, floating, or appearance flicker do not independently fail a Task gate when the relevant attempt, process, or result remains verifiable.
sents.zh: 当相关的尝试、过程或结果仍然可验证时，手部畸形、穿模、悬空或外观闪烁不会单独导致任务（Task）关卡不通过。

sents.en: The rubric even permits Task process credit for its illustrated snapping transfer, while assigning the discontinuity to Physics.
sents.zh: 该评分规则甚至允许为其图示的贴合转移行为给予任务过程分，同时将这种不连续性归入物理（Physics）维度。

sents.en: A defect matters to Task when it destroys or contradicts the evidence required by that gate.
sents.zh: 当缺陷破坏或与该关卡所需的证据相矛盾时，该缺陷才会对任务产生影响。

sents.en: Consequently, a physically impossible execution can receive Task credit, and a physically coherent wrong-object action can fail Task.
sents.zh: 因此，物理上不可能的执行可以获得任务分，而物理上连贯的错误对象动作可能在任务上不通过。

paragraphs.en: Use the subgoals to locate relevant objects and action windows, then assess physical behavior independently of task success. Inspect evidence before, during, and after movement. A window wholly obscured or uninspectable receives N / A \mathrm{N/A} rather than zero or a perfect score. A subgoal with Task level t i = 0 t_{i}=0 has no attempted interaction. It is recorded as unattempted rather than N / A \mathrm{N/A} and is excluded from P P , and a video in which no subgoal is attempted receives a Final score of 0 (Section 4 ). An observable impossible action is still judgeable: it must enter the gate sequence rather than be excluded for being implausible.
paragraphs.zh: 利用子目标定位相关物体与动作窗口，然后独立于任务成功与否评估物理行为。 在移动之前、期间和之后检查证据。 完全被遮挡或无法检查的窗口记为 N / A \mathrm{N/A}，而不是零分或满分。 任务级别 t i = 0 t_{i}=0 的子目标没有尝试过的交互。 它被记录为未尝试而不是 N / A \mathrm{N/A}，并被排除在 P P 之外；没有尝试任何子目标的视频最终得分为 0（第 4 节）。 可观察到的不可能动作仍然可以评判：它必须进入门控序列，而不是因为不合理而被排除。

sents.en: Use the subgoals to locate relevant objects and action windows, then assess physical behavior independently of task success.
sents.zh: 利用子目标定位相关物体与动作窗口，然后独立于任务成功与否评估物理行为。

sents.en: Inspect evidence before, during, and after movement.
sents.zh: 在移动之前、期间和之后检查证据。

sents.en: A window wholly obscured or uninspectable receives N / A \mathrm{N/A} rather than zero or a perfect score.
sents.zh: 完全被遮挡或无法检查的窗口记为 N / A \mathrm{N/A}，而不是零分或满分。

sents.en: A subgoal with Task level t i = 0 t_{i}=0 has no attempted interaction.
sents.zh: 任务级别 t i = 0 t_{i}=0 的子目标没有尝试过的交互。

sents.en: It is recorded as unattempted rather than N / A \mathrm{N/A} and is excluded from P P , and a video in which no subgoal is attempted receives a Final score of 0 (Section 4 ).
sents.zh: 它被记录为未尝试而不是 N / A \mathrm{N/A}，并被排除在 P P 之外；没有尝试任何子目标的视频最终得分为 0（第 4 节）。

sents.en: An observable impossible action is still judgeable: it must enter the gate sequence rather than be excluded for being implausible.
sents.zh: 可观察到的不可能动作仍然可以评判：它必须进入门控序列，而不是因为不合理而被排除。

paragraphs.en: Check identity, count, appearance, material, and traceable paths, including consistency with the most recent preceding action’s end state. Unexplained disappearance, duplication, identity changes, or teleportation fail P1 and give p i = 0 p_{i}=0 . The rubric licenses changes explained by visible processes: splitting, joining, consumption, addition from a source, and revealing previously covered contents. The observed result must match the process, so one visible cut does not license another spontaneous split later. Ordinary occlusion is not disappearance. The rubric also exempts appearance flicker in place and flicker shorter than approximately half a second, whereas a longer unexplained absence is a continuity violation. Timing uses original video time, not the duration of slowed playback.
paragraphs.zh: 检查身份、数量、外观、材质和可追溯路径，包括与最近一个先前动作结束状态的一致性。 无法解释的消失、复制、身份改变或瞬移会导致 P1 失败并给 p_{i}=0。 该评分标准允许由可见过程解释的变化：分裂、合并、消耗、从来源添加，以及揭示先前被遮挡的内容。 观察到的结果必须与该过程相符，因此一次可见的切割不能授权之后另一次自发分裂。 普通的遮挡不是消失。 该评分标准还豁免原位出现闪现和短于约半秒的闪烁，而较长的无法解释的缺失则构成连续性违规。 时间判定使用原始视频时间，而非慢速播放的时长。

sents.zh: 检查身份、数量、外观、材质和可追溯路径，包括与最近一个先前动作结束状态的一致性。

sents.zh: 无法解释的消失、复制、身份改变或瞬移会导致 P1 失败并给 p_{i}=0。

sents.en: The rubric licenses changes explained by visible processes: splitting, joining, consumption, addition from a source, and revealing previously covered contents.
sents.zh: 该评分标准允许由可见过程解释的变化：分裂、合并、消耗、从来源添加，以及揭示先前被遮挡的内容。

sents.en: The observed result must match the process, so one visible cut does not license another spontaneous split later.
sents.zh: 观察到的结果必须与该过程相符，因此一次可见的切割不能授权之后另一次自发分裂。

sents.en: Ordinary occlusion is not disappearance.
sents.zh: 普通的遮挡不是消失。

sents.en: The rubric also exempts appearance flicker in place and flicker shorter than approximately half a second, whereas a longer unexplained absence is a continuity violation.
sents.zh: 该评分标准还豁免原位出现闪现和短于约半秒的闪烁，而较长的无法解释的缺失则构成连续性违规。
